# 🗺️ Your Personalized OSED Study Roadmap

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**📋 Certification:** OSED
**🎯 Your Skill Level:** Intermediate
**📈 Assessment Score:** 0%
**⏱️ Study Duration:** 12 weeks
**📅 Start Date:** February 17, 2026

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# 🚀 YOUR 12-WEEK OSED MASTERY ROADMAP

Welcome to the journey, student! Preparing for the **EXP-301** and the **OSED** certification is a marathon, not a sprint. It requires deep technical dives into Windows internals and the patience of a reverse engineer. 

You have a solid general knowledge base—now it's time to sharpen those skills into a professional exploit developer's toolkit.

> **"Try Harder" isn't just a slogan; it's a methodology. When the debugger crashes and the ROP chain fails, that's where the real learning begins.** 💪

═══════════════════════════════════════

## 📅 PHASE 1: FOUNDATIONS & STACK MASTERY (WEEKS 1-3)

> *Focus: Mastering x86 Assembly, Debuggers, and Reliable Stack Overflows*

**Week 1: The Assembly Language Deep Dive** 📚
• Master x86 registers (EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX, ESI, EDI, EBP, ESP, EIP).

• Understand the stack: PUSH, POP, CALL, RET, and stack frames.

• Practice reading disassembly in WinDbg and x64dbg.

**Week 2: Advanced Stack Overflows** 🎯
• Precise offset identification using `mona.py`.

• Identifying and filtering bad characters manually.

• Learning the "JMP ESP" technique and its limitations.

**Week 3: Shellcode Development (The Manual Way)** 💉
• Writing Position-Independent Code (PIC).

• Null-byte avoidance techniques (XORing registers, using smaller register parts).

• Creating custom encoders/decoders for restricted buffers.

═══════════════════════════════════════

## 📅 PHASE 2: SEH & REVERSE ENGINEERING (WEEKS 4-6)

> *Focus: Bypassing SEH Protections and Finding Vulnerabilities*

**Week 4: Structured Exception Handling (SEH)** 🎭
• Understand the SEH chain and Exception Registration Records.

• Master the POP-POP-RET (PPR) technique.

• Bypassing SafeSEH using non-SafeSEH modules.

**Week 5: Reverse Engineering for Bug Hunting** 🔍
• Intro to static analysis with IDA Pro or Ghidra.

• Identifying vulnerable functions (strcpy, memcpy, gets).

• Understanding the Import Address Table (IAT) and Export Address Table (EAT).

**Week 6: Fuzzing & Crash Analysis** 🐛
• Setting up mutation-based fuzzers.

• Analyzing crashes in WinDbg to determine exploitability.

• Automating the triage process for unique crashes.

═══════════════════════════════════════

## 📅 PHASE 3: THE ROP REVOLUTION (WEEKS 7-9)

> *Focus: Bypassing DEP and ASLR with Return-Oriented Programming*

**Week 7: ROP Fundamentals** ⚙️
• Finding gadgets using `ROPgadget` or `mona.py`.

• Understanding stack pivoting techniques.

• Building basic ROP chains to execute simple functions.

**Week 8: Bypassing DEP (Data Execution Prevention)** 🛡️
• Constructing `VirtualProtect()` ROP chains.

• Using `VirtualAlloc()` to create executable memory.

• Dealing with restricted character sets in ROP gadgets.

**Week 9: Bypassing ASLR & Advanced ROP** 🔓
• Identifying and exploiting memory leaks to defeat ASLR.

• Using non-ASLR modules as a baseline.

• Multi-stage ROP chains and complex stack pivots.

═══════════════════════════════════════

## 📅 PHASE 4: REFINEMENT & EXAM PREP (WEEKS 10-12)

> *Focus: Reliability, Speed, and Professional Reporting*

**Week 10: Exploit Reliability & Egg Hunters** ⚡
• Writing efficient Egg Hunters for limited buffer space.

• Ensuring exploits work across different Windows versions.

• Handling socket reuse and complex network protocols.

**Week 11: Mock Exams & Time Management** ⏱️
• Practice on **VulnServer** (all functions).

• Complete the **Corelan** tutorials (advanced modules).

• Practice exploitation under a 24-hour time constraint.

**Week 12: The Final Countdown** ✅
• Review all custom shellcode templates.

• Practice report writing: Clear screenshots and reproducible steps.

• Organize your "Cheat Sheets" for WinDbg and Mona commands.

═══════════════════════════════════════

## 💡 SUCCESS TIPS FOR OSED

1️⃣ **Document Everything:** Keep a snippet library of every ROP gadget and shellcode trick you learn.

2️⃣ **Verify Early:** Never build a full ROP chain before verifying your offset and EIP control with simple 'B's.

3️⃣ **The Debugger is Your Friend:** If an exploit fails, don't guess. Step through the assembly instruction by instruction to find where the stack is misaligned.

4️⃣ **Take Breaks:** Exploit dev is mentally taxing. If you've been staring at a hex dump for 3 hours, walk away for 15 minutes. The answer often comes when you aren't looking at the screen.

═══════════════════════════════════════

## 🛠️ ESSENTIAL RESOURCES

• **Official Course Material:** Your primary source of truth.

• **Practice Labs:** Essential for hands-on exploitation.

• **VulnServer:** The gold standard for practicing Windows exploit dev.

• **Mona.py Documentation:** Master the tool that makes OSED possible.

• **x86 Instruction Set Reference:** Keep this open while writing shellcode.

**You've got this! Stay focused, stay curious, and most importantly... Try Harder! 💪🚀**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**🤝 Community Resources:**

- InfoSec Prep Discord

## 🎯 Remember

✨ **Consistency** is more important than intensity
💪 **Try Harder** - but also take breaks when stuck
📝 **Document everything** - your notes will save you during the exam
🔄 **Review regularly** - revisit topics you've learned
❤️ **Join the community** - learn from others on the same journey

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**📋 Certification:** KLCP
**🎯 Your Skill Level:** Intermediate

**📅 Start Date:** February 18, 2026

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# 🐉 KLCP: THE KALI MASTER ROADMAP 🚀

Welcome, student! You’ve got the intermediate foundation, but now it’s time to master the ultimate penetration testing platform. To earn the **Kali Linux Certified Professional (KLCP)**, you must go beyond just "using" tools—you must understand the system that powers them.

> **"It’s not about the tool; it’s about how you wield it. Try Harder!"** 💪

═══════════════════════════════════════

### 📅 PHASE 1: KALI CORE & SYSTEM MASTERY (WEEKS 1-3)

> **Focus: Mastering the Debian-based architecture and command-line efficiency.**

**Week 1: Installation & Architecture** 🐧
• Master the Kali rolling release model and repository management (`/etc/apt/sources.list`).
• Practice custom installations: encrypted persistence on Live USB and WSL2 setups.
• Learn to navigate the filesystem like a pro (know where `/usr/share/wordlists` and `/usr/share/doc` live).

**Week 2: The Power of the Shell** ⚡
• Advanced Bash: Piping, redirection, and text manipulation (`grep`, `sed`, `awk`, `cut`).
• Environment customization: Mastering `.zshrc`, aliases, and PATH variables.
• Process management: `systemctl`, `service`, and backgrounding tasks with `&` and `disown`.

**Week 3: Package & Service Management** 📦
• Deep dive into `apt` vs `dpkg` and fixing broken dependencies (`--fix-broken install`).
• Learn to build tools from source and manage Kali Metapackages (`kali-linux-everything`).
• Service hardening: Configuring and securing SSH, Apache, and PostgreSQL for Metasploit.

═══════════════════════════════════════

### 📅 PHASE 2: TOOLSET DEEP DIVE (WEEKS 4-7)

> **Focus: Mastery of the "Top 20" tools and workflow automation.**

**Week 4: Information Gathering & Scanning** 🔍
• Nmap mastery: Scripting Engine (NSE), timing templates, and output formatting.
• Vulnerability analysis: Using `nikto`, `wpscan`, and manual enumeration techniques.

**Week 5: Exploitation Frameworks** 🚀
• Metasploit Framework: Database integration (`msfdb init`), workspace management, and payload generation (`msfvenom`).
• SearchSploit and manual exploit modification from Exploit-DB.

**Week 6: Web & Wireless Mastery** 🌐
• Burp Suite: Proxying, Repeater, and Intruder basics.
• Wireless: `airmon-ng` workflows, monitor mode troubleshooting, and packet injection.

**Week 7: Password Attacks & PrivEsc** 🔓
• Cracking: `John the Ripper` and `Hashcat` logic.
• Privilege Escalation: Using `LinPEAS` and understanding GTFOBins for binary exploitation.

═══════════════════════════════════════

### 📅 PHASE 3: ADVANCED KALI OPERATIONS (WEEKS 8-10)

> **Focus: Customization, stealth, and complex networking.**

**Week 8: Custom Kali Builds (ISO of Doom)** 🛠️
• Learn `live-build` to create your own custom Kali ISO with pre-installed scripts.
• Configure "Undercover Mode" and kernel tuning for specific hardware.

**Week 9: Networking & Pivoting** 📡
• Advanced networking: `ip`, `route`, and manual interface configuration.
• Pivoting: SSH Tunneling, `Proxychains`, and `Chisel` for lateral movement.

**Week 10: Scripting for Automation** 🐍
• Write Bash and Python wrappers for multi-tool workflows.
• Automate the "Recon -> Scan -> Report" pipeline.

═══════════════════════════════════════

### 📅 PHASE 4: THE FINAL COUNTDOWN (WEEKS 11-12)

> **Focus: Mock exams, reporting, and speed.**

**Week 11: Mock Exams & Speed Runs** ⏱️
• Set up a lab with 5 random VulnHub/HTB machines and try to compromise them using a strict Kali-only methodology.
• Practice "Tool Chaining": Moving data from Nmap to Metasploit to Burp seamlessly.

**Week 12: Documentation & Reporting Practice** 📝
• Practice taking professional screenshots with `Flameshot` or `Spectacle`.
• Organize your notes using CherryTree or Obsidian.
• Review the official reporting requirements and build a template.

═══════════════════════════════════════

### 💡 TOP 5 ESSENTIAL RESOURCES

1️⃣ [Kali Linux Official Documentation](https://www.kali.org/docs/) - The ultimate source of truth.
2️⃣ [Kali Linux Revealed Book](https://www.kali.org/download-kali-linux-revealed-book/) - The "Bible" for the KLCP exam.
3️⃣ [OffSec Proving Grounds](https://www.offsec.com/labs/) - Best place for OSCP/KLCP style practice.
4️⃣ [Exploit Database](https://www.exploit-db.com/) - Essential for understanding exploit modification.
5️⃣ [GTFOBins](https://gtfobins.github.io/) - Critical for Linux privilege escalation.

> **Time Investment Estimate:** 10-15 hours per week.

═══════════════════════════════════════

### ✅ WEEKLY MILESTONES

• **Week 2:** Able to write a Bash script that automates an Nmap scan and parses the output.
• **Week 5:** Successfully initialize and use the Metasploit database for every lab machine.
• **Week 8:** Successfully build a custom Kali ISO with at least one non-standard tool included.
• **Week 12:** Complete a full 24-hour mock pentest and generate a professional 20-page report.

═══════════════════════════════════════

### 🔥 SUCCESS TIPS

• ⚠️ **Common Pitfall:** Don't just learn the tools; learn the **Linux commands** behind them. If the GUI fails, you must survive in the CLI.
• ⚡ **Efficiency:** Master `tmux`. Being able to manage multiple windows and panes is the difference between passing and failing a 24-hour exam.
• 🎯 **Mindset:** When a tool breaks, don't switch OS. Fix the tool. That is the essence of being a Kali Professional.

**Go get 'em. Try Harder! 💪** 🐉
